user.title: Connect Duke Energy usage
user.description: Version {version}. Choose the cumulative kWh statistic imported by the official Duke Energy integration.

data_description.source_statistic: Cumulative kWh sum statistic from the official Duke Energy integration.
data_description.name: Name for the device and generated statistics.
data_description.billing_cycle_day: Day 1–28 when the account's billing cycle normally begins.
data_description.currency: Currency used by the cost statistics; normally USD.

state.title: Choose the service state
state.description: Choose the state printed in the service address on the bill.

data_description.state: This filters the available Duke Energy utilities and residential plans.

service_area.title: Choose the Duke Energy utility
service_area.description: {state} is served by more than one Duke Energy operating company. Choose the exact company name printed on the bill.

data_description.service_area: Rates with similar plan codes can differ substantially between operating companies.

plan.title: Choose the bill plan
plan.description: Plans available for {service_area}. Match the plan name or abbreviation shown on the bill; a leaf number is not required.

data_description.tariff_profile: For example, a bill saying ‘Residential Service (RES)’ should use Residential Service (RES).

rates.title: Review rates and adjustments
rates.description: {plan}. {details} Review the prefilled values against a recent bill; only fields used by this plan are shown.

data.grid_access_rate: Grid-access charge per solar kW above 15 kW

data_description.basic_charge: Fixed charge added once per billing cycle, in USD.
data_description.three_phase_charge: Additional fixed charge for a three-phase residential account, in USD per cycle.
data_description.three_phase: Enable only when the bill identifies three-phase residential service.
data_description.energy_rate: Flat price for each kWh, in USD/kWh.
data_description.summer_rate: Price used in the plan's defined summer months, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_first_rate: Price for the first winter or non-seasonal tier, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_additional_rate: Price above the first winter or non-seasonal tier, in USD/kWh.
data_description.tier_kwh: Energy included before the next tier begins, in kWh per billing cycle.
data_description.tier_1_rate: Price for energy in tier 1, in USD/kWh.
data_description.tier_2_kwh: Cumulative kWh where tier 2 ends; tier 3 begins above it.
data_description.tier_2_rate: Price for energy in tier 2, in USD/kWh.
data_description.tier_3_rate: Price above tier 2, or the published summer additional-tier price where applicable, in USD/kWh.
data_description.on_peak_rate: Price during the plan's on-peak windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.off_peak_rate: Price during ordinary off-peak windows, in USD/kWh.
data_description.discount_rate: Price during the plan's lowest-price discount window, in USD/kWh.
data_description.super_off_peak_rate: Solar-plan price during the super off-peak window, in USD/kWh.
data_description.critical_peak_rate: Price during an announced critical-peak event, in USD/kWh.
data_description.standard_rate: Price outside the EV overnight discount window, in USD/kWh.
data_description.summer_on_peak_rate: Summer price during on-peak hours, in USD/kWh.
data_description.summer_off_peak_rate: Summer price outside on-peak hours, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_on_peak_rate: Winter price during on-peak hours, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_off_peak_rate: Winter price outside on-peak hours, in USD/kWh.
data_description.on_peak_demand_rate: Charge for the cycle's highest on-peak demand, in USD/kW.
data_description.max_demand_rate: Charge for the cycle's highest demand at any time, in USD/kW.
data_description.demand_mode: Hourly data can only approximate a 15- or 30-minute billing demand. Manual values from the bill are more accurate.
data_description.manual_on_peak_kw: Monthly billed on-peak demand in kW; used only in manual mode.
data_description.manual_max_kw: Monthly billed maximum demand in kW; used only in manual mode.
data_description.minimum_bill: Minimum charge before tax for a billing cycle. The estimate is held at this floor until calculated charges exceed it.
data_description.system_size_kw: Rated solar system capacity in kW; enter 0 when not applicable.
data_description.non_bypassable_rate: Monthly solar charge multiplied by system kW, in USD/kW.
data_description.grid_access_rate: Monthly charge applied to solar capacity above 15 kW, in USD/kW.
data_description.cpp_events: Announced event dates separated by commas or new lines. Use YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD@HH to supply a start hour.
data_description.additional_kwh_rate: Combined riders, fuel, supplier, or other usage adjustment, in USD/kWh. A negative value represents a credit.
data_description.monthly_adjustment: Other fixed amount per cycle in USD; use a negative value for a credit.
data_description.tax_percent: Percentage applied to estimated charges. Enter 7 for 7%, not 0.07.

error.invalid_energy_statistic: Select a sum statistic measured in kWh.
error.invalid_cpp_events: Use comma- or line-separated YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD@HH entries.

data_description.summer_rate: Price in the plan's summer months, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_first_rate: Price for the first winter or ordinary tier, in USD/kWh.
data_description.winter_additional_rate: Price above the first winter or ordinary tier, in USD/kWh.
data_description.tier_kwh: Energy before the next tier, in kWh per cycle.
data_description.tier_3_rate: Tier 3 or summer additional price, in USD/kWh.
data_description.standard_rate: Price outside the EV discount window, in USD/kWh.
data_description.on_peak_demand_rate: Cycle on-peak demand charge, in USD/kW.
data_description.demand_mode: Hourly data is an approximation; manual bill values are more accurate.
data_description.manual_on_peak_kw: Bill on-peak demand in kW, used only in manual mode.
data_description.manual_max_kw: Bill maximum demand in kW, used only in manual mode.
data_description.minimum_bill: Pre-tax cycle floor until calculated charges exceed it.
data_description.system_size_kw: Rated solar capacity in kW; use 0 when not applicable.
data_description.non_bypassable_rate: Monthly solar charge in USD per system kW.
data_description.grid_access_rate: Monthly USD/kW charge on capacity above 15 kW.

data_description.monthly_adjustment: Other fixed USD amount per cycle; credits may be negative.
